reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Mississippi
    Focus year: 2021
    Question: Must an eviction summons served to tenants describe the landlord's rights to dispose of tenant property?
*/

/* -----------------------------
   Scenario facts (question statement)
   ----------------------------- */

scenario_state(mississippi).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

/* We encode the question as concerning an "eviction summons" served to a tenant.
   In Mississippi, MS Code  89-7-31 (2020) specifically governs a "summons" issued on an affidavit
   requiring the occupant to remove or show cause, and expressly mandates a property-disposal warning
   statement be included in the summons. */
scenario_document(eviction_summons).
scenario_served_to(tenant).
scenario_eviction_procedure(ms_89_7_31_affidavit_summons).

/* scenario_statement/0 succeeds when the factual statement (as encoded) holds. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(mississippi),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_document(eviction_summons),
    scenario_served_to(tenant),
    scenario_eviction_procedure(ms_89_7_31_affidavit_summons).

/* -----------------------------
   Statute translations (deterministic predicates)
   ----------------------------- */

/* Helper: year applicability check */
statute_effective_from(ms_code_11_25_7, 2020).
statute_effective_from(ms_code_11_25_107, 2020).
statute_effective_from(ms_code_89_7_31, 2020).

year_is_on_or_after(Year, FromYear) :-
    integer(Year),
    integer(FromYear),
    Year >= FromYear.

/* --- MS Code  11-25-7 (2020): justice court warrant form (unlawful ouster/withholding)
   Encodes required elements (high-level), and notably does NOT require a tenant-property-disposal notice. */
statute_ms_11_25_7_requires_element(describe_land).
statute_ms_11_25_7_requires_element(command_to_summon_defendant).
statute_ms_11_25_7_requires_element(appearance_place_usual_justice_court_location).
statute_ms_11_25_7_requires_element(appearance_date).
statute_ms_11_25_7_requires_element(answer_complaint).
statute_ms_11_25_7_requires_element(clerk_signature).

statute_ms_11_25_7_requires_property_disposal_notice(no).

/* --- MS Code  11-25-107 (2020): county court warrant form (unlawful ouster/withholding)
   Encodes required elements (high-level), and does NOT require a tenant-property-disposal notice. */
statute_ms_11_25_107_requires_element(describe_land).
statute_ms_11_25_107_requires_element(command_to_summon_defendant).
statute_ms_11_25_107_requires_element(appearance_place_usual_county_court_location).
statute_ms_11_25_107_requires_element(appearance_date).
statute_ms_11_25_107_requires_element(answer_complaint).
statute_ms_11_25_107_requires_element(clerk_or_judge_signature).

statute_ms_11_25_107_requires_property_disposal_notice(no).

/* --- MS Code  89-7-31 (2020): summons on affidavit; must include a specific notice.
   Key encoding: "In addition to other information required for the summons, the summons shall state: ..."
*/
statute_ms_89_7_31_summons_core_elements([
    directed_to_sheriff_or_constable_or_marshal,
    describes_premises,
    commands_person_in_possession_to_immediately_remove_or_show_cause,
    hearing_day_named_in_summons
]).

/* The required warning statement about the landlord's ability to dispose of personal property. */
statute_ms_89_7_31_requires_property_disposal_notice(yes).

/* Applicability: Mississippi + year on/after effective + this procedure uses the  89-7-31 summons. */
statute_ms_89_7_31_applies(State, Year, Procedure, DocumentType) :-
    State = mississippi,
    DocumentType = eviction_summons,
    Procedure = ms_89_7_31_affidavit_summons,
    statute_effective_from(ms_code_89_7_31, FromYear),
    year_is_on_or_after(Year, FromYear).

/* -----------------------------
   Legal reasoning (derive answer)
   ----------------------------- */

/* The question asks if the eviction summons must describe landlord rights to dispose of tenant property.
   We treat that as "property disposal notice required in the summons." */
eviction_summons_must_describe_landlord_property_disposal_rights(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_state(State),
    scenario_focus_year(Year),
    scenario_eviction_procedure(Procedure),
    scenario_document(DocumentType),
    statute_ms_89_7_31_applies(State, Year, Procedure, DocumentType),
    statute_ms_89_7_31_requires_property_disposal_notice(yes),
    !.
eviction_summons_must_describe_landlord_property_disposal_rights(no) :-
    !.

/* -----------------------------
   Final required predicate
   ----------------------------- */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    eviction_summons_must_describe_landlord_property_disposal_rights(yes),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

/* -----------------------------
   Main entrypoint (required)
   ----------------------------- */

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it required that the evictions summons served to tenants describe what rights the landlord has to dispose of the tenant’s property?
